name: pi-0 (pi-zero)
summary: pi-0 pairs a PaliGemma 3B VLM with a separate ~300M action expert that generates action chunks via conditional flow matching, trained on roughly 10k hours across 7 robot configurations plus Open X-Embodiment. Continuous, high-frequency output unlocked genuinely dexterous long-horizon tasks (folding laundry from a dryer, bussing tables, assembling boxes) that token-based VLAs could not touch. Weights were released as openpi in early 2025.
innovation: Flow matching for action generation: continuous, multimodal and high-frequency rather than discretized.
A dedicated action expert with its own weights attending to VLM features, separating semantics from motor control.
An explicit pretrain-then-post-train recipe borrowed from LLM practice, with curated post-training data.
matters: Set the current architectural template: VLM backbone plus flow or diffusion action expert.
openpi made a frontier-quality VLA openly available and is now a standard starting point.
limits: Post-training data quality dominates results, and that data remains proprietary and expensive.
lineage: RT-2's VLM backbone idea with Diffusion Policy's continuous action generation, upgraded to flow matching.
